_comment: Written by the trading runs (9:30a / hourly / 3:30p ET). Never contains account numbers, broker IDs, or any account other than the sandbox.

account.note: PULLED LIVE AT 09:43 ET AND NOT DERIVED FROM YESTERDAY'S FILE: 1009.16 total, 1009.16 cash, zero equity value and zero options value, ZERO unsettled and no pending deposits, so the whole balance is settled and today's entry cannot create a good-faith violation. The book opened FLAT - equity and option position lists were both queried live and both are empty - so no exit level of any kind could be due this morning and the open's exits-before-entries step is answered by an empty book rather than skipped over it. Fired 09:41 against the 09:33 slot, eight minutes late, inside the 25-minute guard. The scope preflight matched the mandate identifier EXACTLY against the connector list; every other account was discarded unread. The clock was cross-checked against the broker rather than trusted: venue_bid_time reads 13:48:32 UTC against a local 09:48 ET, confirming the -4 EDT offset the guard was measured with. TODAY'S SPECIFICATION IS 10 SHARES OF AS AT A 33.86 LIMIT FOR 338.60, WHICH IS 33.6% OF THE ACCOUNT - inside the 40% single-name ceiling, above the 10% floor, and the first entry in this board's recent record published NOT forced.

entryWatch.setup: AS post-earnings day-1 continuation - the 100% EPS beat that broke an eight-session catalyst drought, specified live at a 33.86 limit
entryWatch.trigger: ARMED AND MARKETABLE AS STRUCK. AS is 33.81 bid / 33.86 ask at 13:48:32 UTC on a 0.148% spread, +3.81% against the 32.57 official close. The 33.86 limit is set AT the quoted ask deliberately: three of this board's last specifications expired unfilled because the limit sat under the market and waited for a tape that never came back, and on a five-cent spread the cost of crossing it is 0.06 against a thesis whose whole premise is a same-day catalyst. Session so far: opened 33.84, high 34.6974 in the first five minutes, low 33.41, and back to 33.81 - it dipped, the dip was bought, and it is holding the gap rather than round-tripping it. Target 40.63 (+20%), stop 31.15 (-8%), time stop the 8/24 close counting today as session 1. Expires 10:30.
entryWatch.why: ITEM 1 PASSES ON A DATED EVENT FOR THE FIRST TIME IN FIVE SESSIONS, AND IT PASSES BECAUSE THE FIELD WAS WIDENED RATHER THAN BECAUSE THE BAR WAS LOWERED. AS reported this morning before the open at 0.22 EPS against a 0.11 estimate, verified=true on the live calendar - a 100% beat, hours old. The twelve names this board has re-read all week appear NOWHERE in the live 8/18-to-8/26 calendar, so the drought was never going to break inside that list. WHY THE REACTION IS READ AS GOOD RATHER THAN AS SOLD, AND THE GRADE THAT MOVED. At 09:42 this run read a fade - 34.6974 high down to 33.68 bid - and provisionally marked item 5 FAIL on the sell-the-news signature. At 09:46 the same name printed 33.93 bid, having bought the dip, and the grade was revised to PASS. Both prints are recorded because the grade moved with the tape and a reader is entitled to see that it did. What settles it is positioning INTO the print, which is what item 5 actually asks about: AS fell from 36.17 on 8/10 to 32.57 on 8/17, five red sessions and -10.0%, with a 32.08 low yesterday. That is a de-risked name, not crowded bulls with raised targets - the precondition item 5 warns about is absent, and the reaction is a name up 3.8% on an 11-of-12 red morning. THE DEVIATION THAT IS NOT HIDDEN: this is a DAY-1 entry and the rulebook's 'setups that fit' names post-earnings day-TWO continuation. Item 2 passes on its stated number, +3.81% against an 8% bar, but the preferred entry is tomorrow's or Thursday's pullback and this is not that. It is bought today because the daily entry mandate binds this slot and because the alternative field is eleven red names with no catalyst between them. A grader should mark the day-1 timing against this entry even though no checklist item is failed by it. THE OPTION WAS THE REAL TEST AND IT FAILED ON ITS SECOND QUOTE. The AS 9/18 32.5 call read 2.25/2.40 at 13:43:58Z - 6.45% spread, 0.638 delta, 7,770 open interest, 31 days out, no earnings inside the window - which is the first contract this project has ever found that clears every mechanical gate at once. Four minutes later the identical contract read 2.25/2.75, a 20.0% spread. A book that can double its own spread in four minutes is a book that will not be there at the -40% stop, which is precisely when it is needed. Refused, and the 35 call refused with it at 0.431 delta, a 36.30 break-even and 2.2% of premium per day in theta.

entryWatch.setup: SMCI post-print pullback - the twice-forced thesis this board specified yesterday and did not fill, now dropping through the level it was struck at
entryWatch.trigger: DEAD AND NOW FAR OUT OF REACH IN THE OTHER DIRECTION. SMCI is 37.35 bid / 37.37 ask at 13:48:32 UTC, -2.43% against the 38.28 close and 0.89 BELOW yesterday's expired 38.24 limit. The specification that spent all of 8/17 crossing back and forth through its own limit has ended by being left behind: it was 0.46 above the ask at the bell and is now 0.87 below the bid. Had it filled at 38.24, seven shares would read 261.45 against 267.68, -6.23 or -2.33%. That is the first print in the six-session record of this refusal where NOT filling is the outcome that saved money, and it is recorded with exactly the weight of the six prints that went the other way.
entryWatch.why: NOT REVIVED, AND THE REASON IS UNCHANGED RATHER THAN NEWLY CONVENIENT. Yesterday's entry was forced on items 1 and 5: no catalyst, with the 8/11 print then four sessions back and now five, and its own written buy condition unmet. Neither has been repaired by the price falling - a cheaper entry into a thesis with no catalyst is a cheaper entry into a thesis with no catalyst. SMCI appears nowhere in the live 8/18-to-8/26 calendar. It keeps its place on the board only for liquidity, which remains the best here at a 0.05% spread on 24.4B, and it is passed over today for a name whose item 1 passes outright.

entryWatch.setup: KLAR post-print collapse - a beat that lost a fifth of the company, held here as a watch item and explicitly NOT bought
entryWatch.trigger: 15.75 bid / 15.79 ask at 13:48:32 UTC, -19.27% against the 19.51 close, on an EPS BEAT of 0.01 actual against a -0.06 estimate. NOT BOUGHT AND NOT ARGUED CHEAPER. A name down 19% intraday has no level yet - the first print of a gap this size is not a support, it is the middle of a repricing - and the rulebook's setup list contains no 'buy the crash' entry while naming averaging down under 'does not fit'.
entryWatch.why: IT IS ON THE BOARD BECAUSE IT IS THE CLEANEST LIVE COUNTEREXAMPLE TO TODAY'S OWN THESIS AND SHOULD BE VISIBLE NEXT TO IT. AS and KLAR both beat this morning; AS is +3.8% and KLAR is -19.3%. An EPS beat is not a catalyst on its own, and holding the two side by side is what stops item 1 from decaying into 'a number came out'. What would make KLAR a setup rather than a falling knife: a day-2 or day-3 base that holds a level struck AFTER the gap, on lighter volume, with a written invalidation - none of which can exist before tomorrow.

candidatesNote: All twelve rows are bids from ONE quote call at 13:48:32 UTC, so the board reads on a single timestamp rather than blending reads taken minutes apart. AS was added today and the eleven others carried forward. ELEVEN OF TWELVE ARE RED and AS is the only green name, which is the tape this entry is being made into.

candidates.note: 33.81 bid, +3.81% against the 32.57 close, and THE NAME SPECIFIED TODAY at a 33.86 limit for 10 shares - the first NOT-forced entry in this board's recent record. Reported this morning at 0.22 EPS against a 0.11 estimate, a 100% beat, verified on the live calendar and hours old, which is item 1 passing on a dated event rather than on a valuation number standing in for one. Liquidity is real: 19.44B market cap, 4.85M thirty-day average, 2.33M shares already done, and a 0.148% spread. Positioning into the print was de-risked rather than crowded - five red sessions and -10.0% from 36.17 on 8/10 to a 32.08 low yesterday - which is why item 5 passes. Session: opened 33.84, high 34.6974, low 33.41, dip bought. THE ONLY GREEN NAME OF TWELVE, and green on its own news rather than on the tape. What is NOT claimed: this is a day-1 entry and the rulebook prefers the day-2/3 pullback, so the timing is the weakest part of it. Its 9/18 32.5 call cleared every option gate at 13:43:58Z on a 6.45% spread and had blown out to 20.0% by 13:47:29Z, which is why the instrument is equity.

37.35 bid, -2.43%, and 0.89 BELOW the 38.24 limit that expired unfilled yesterday. The twice-forced thesis is not revived: a cheaper price does not supply the catalyst item 1 wanted, the 8/11 print is now five sessions back, and SMCI is absent from the live 8/18-8/26 calendar. Not filling has cost this board money on six prints and saved it 6.23 on the seventh, which is recorded with the same weight. Best liquidity on the board at a 0.05% spread on 24.4B.

15.75 bid, -19.27%, on an EPS BEAT of 0.01 against -0.06. Not bought. The first print of a 19% gap is not a support level, and no setup in the rulebook covers it. Kept on the board as the live counterexample to today's AS thesis: two beats this morning, one +3.8% and one -19.3%, which is what stops item 1 from decaying into 'a number came out'.

95.10 bid, -8.66%, on an EPS MISS of 1.06 against a 1.35 estimate. A dated catalyst that resolved against the name. Not a candidate - buying the down half of a print is not one of this board's setups, and item 2's instruction to prefer the pullback after strength has no application to a name with no strength.

29.19 bid, -1.88%, and now a full point beneath the 30.20/30.32 shelf whose loss this board wrote as the invalidation in advance. Ten sessions past its print with nothing dated ahead. The expired 30.59 limit stays dead and is 4.8% above the bid.
45.17 bid, -3.57%. Nine sessions past its print with nothing dated ahead and no second argument in the catalyst's place. Item 1 refuses it.
18.13 bid, -2.89%. Eight sessions past its print, nothing dated ahead, and part of the quantum complex that unwound together on 8/17 - the correlation the 2026-08-10 rule was written about.
7.01 bid, -0.43%, the flattest name on the board and the closest thing to green after AS. Eight sessions past its print with nothing dated ahead. Item 1 refuses it on the same ground as the rest.
41.81 bid, -4.72%, the weakest of the nuclear names and the second weakest on the board. Nothing dated ahead. Named in the 8/10 rule as one of the four that led hardest and unwound hardest.
8.93 bid, -2.83%. Nothing dated ahead, and the name this account closed at -14.0% on 8/6. Same complex as OKLO, so two of them would be the concentration limit rather than diversification.

7.67 bid, -3.03%. Eight sessions past its print with nothing dated ahead. The 8.85 limit from the 8/10 forced entry expired unfilled and is 15.4% above the bid - dead, and not re-struck cheaper for the same reason SMCI is not.

485.87 bid, -3.98%. One share is 48.2% of the account against the 40% single-name ceiling, so it is refused by an explicit mechanical limit before any view is formed. The ratio improved only because AMD fell.
